message.content: {"research_brief": "How did the HyperFund/HyperVerse alleged crypto-fraud network operate and recruit investors, specifically through (1) alleged crypto-Ponzi or pyramid-style mechanics, including promised returns, referral or recruitment incentives, payment flows, and investor-facing representations; (2) public promoters, influencers, executives, or other endorsers and their roles in attracting credibility or participants; (3) rebranding or organizational changes from HyperFund to HyperVerse and any related entities, platforms, or identities; and (4) the creation, use, or questioning of the CEO persona and its relationship to the network’s legitimacy claims—using only evidence returned by the benchmark tools, citing only tool-returned source IDs, distinguishing verified facts from allegations, assessments, inferences, and uncertainty, identifying supported entities and relationships without inventing unsupported IDs or relationship names, documenting relevant chronology and contradictions, and returning a complete Markdown report followed by a fenced JSON object whose arrays are exactly `findings`, `claims`, `reasoning_steps`, and `contradictions`, with each finding containing `question`, `answer`, `supporting_entities`, and `source_references`; each claim containing `claim` and `source_references`; each reasoning step containing `id`, `conclusion`, `premise_entities`, and `premise_relations`; and each contradiction containing `contradiction_id`, `description`, and `source_references`?"}
